dialogues.speaker: Farid
dialogues.text: Yeah. It's my job to patrol around.

dialogues.speaker: Farid
dialogues.text: There's no danger around here. You can travel as you wish.

dialogues.speaker: Farid
dialogues.text: But that isn't necessarily true. A few days ago, there were two groups of researchers here who started a group fight. I was almost pulled into it.

dialogues.speaker: Farid
dialogues.text: Even in Sumeru City, you can still be in danger when faced with researchers who seem mild-mannered. It is a must to always be on the alert.
